title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally stable but notes some occasional fatigue and mild swelling in his lower extremities. He denies any acute shortness of breath, chest pain, or significant changes in urinary output. He is adherent to his current medication regimen and reports no new side effects.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily, Furosemide 40mg daily.

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Lower extremities show trace pitting edema. Skin is intact with no new lesions.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 4.

Plan
The patient will continue his current medications. We will monitor his laboratory values, specifically serum creatinine and potassium levels, over the next three months. He was instructed to report any sudden weight gain or increased swelling immediately. Follow-up in 3 months.
